orderSlots.label: Order slots
orderSlots.description: How many orders a player can have at once.

standardPrices.label: Prices in Standard
standardPrices.description: The official Path of Exile league whose prices the Standard league here trades at.

leaguePrices.label: Prices in other leagues
leaguePrices.description: The official Path of Exile league whose prices every other league here trades at, Hardcore among them.

spreadScale.label: Spread
spreadScale.description: Multiplies how far from the official price Faustus trades: 1% for the busiest items, up to 10% for the rarest. Lower is cheaper; 0 trades at the price itself.

volumeShare.label: Share of the market
volumeShare.description: How much of an item's official hourly trade Faustus offers in an hour, and at least one of it on each of 6 steps. 0: no limit, every order fills at once.

patientRange.label: Patient orders
patientRange.description: How much of the way from the buying price to the selling price an order fills with time. 100%: as a live market, so a player can earn the spread. 50%: only up to the official price, so they cannot. 0: none.

patientSpeed.label: Patient order speed
patientSpeed.description: How much faster such orders fill: by default at most 5 minutes for the busiest items and 12 hours for the rarest.

catchUpHours.label: Trading while away
catchUpHours.description: How many hours away an order catches up on when the player returns. 0: only the current hour's price counts.

goldFee.label: Gold fee
goldFee.description: Multiplies the gold an order pays.

maxRateAgeDays.label: Oldest rates
maxRateAgeDays.description: Rates older than this are not traded at: the market shows no stock until new ones arrive.

faustusSpeaks.label: Faustus speaks
faustusSpeaks.description: He says a line when an order is placed or filled.

url.label: Rates service
url.description: The address of the rates service.
